bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable. Tables open at 12pm Pacific time exactly 30 days before the date.
walkIns: Some seats are kept for walk-ins, first come, first served. Arrive a few minutes before the 5:30pm opening for a shorter wait, earlier at weekends.
groups: Online bookings are for one to four guests. The Alcove Table seats six to eight at 6pm or 8:30pm, with a $110 family-style menu and an $800 food and drink minimum; cancelling within five days costs half the minimum, on the day the full minimum. The whole restaurant can be booked for up to 60 seated or 75 standing.
